Nzọụkwụ 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) na-emeghachi omume na HCl 1:1, ya mere HCl 0.050 mol dị n'ime 25 mL. Ọnụọgụ = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
